text: A prompt is simply what you type to Claude.
To get great results, ask clearly, just as you would with a new colleague.

Every effective request includes four parts: Situation, explaining who you are; Goal, stating exactly what you want produced; Background, providing the facts and files Claude needs; and Format, specifying structure, length, and tone.
You can also paste an example to imitate, set boundaries like avoiding jargon, and break big jobs into steps.
Treat the first reply as a working draft: a quick follow-up correction saves time and guides Claude to the exact answer you need.
